description: The ONLY policy and decision authority in the control system. All policy evaluation, workflow authorization, entitlement resolution, governance lifecycle, and audit recording flows through this app. No other app may make these decisions.
nonNegotiableRules: This app is the ONLY source of policy decisions
All workflow triggers must be authorized through authority/authorize-workflow
All governance mutations must flow through server/governance/state-machine
All audit events must be recorded with hash-chain integrity
Decision events are immutable once written
No other app may call platformDb for policy/governance/audit operations
